title: 六百海里（餐饮店设计） - 厦门店面装修设计公司-创意店铺设计-锐伽店面设计案例 - 锐咖
body_text:
项目 Clinet：600 N MILE
地址 Location：厦门 福建
设计 Design：修扬
效果Effect：YoYo
时间 Year：2020.1
面积 Area：75
带着数字的名称有一种神秘的魔力——知道答案却不知道题目的命题更让人有探寻的欲望。
Names with numbers have a kind of mysterious magic-propositions that know the answer but don't know the title make people more eager to explore.
600 N MILE 是什么？
其实是男主人跟女主人故乡的距离（台湾跟厦门相差160海里，但为了让名称更有吸引力跟深度，艺术加工成600海里） ，然后，我们还可以臆想出很多场景出来：600海里的美食、600海里的爱情、600海里的风和雨。
What is 600 N MILE?
In fact, it is the distance between the hometown of the host and the hostess (the difference between Taiwan and Xiamen is 160 nautical miles, but in order to make the name more attractive and deep, the art is processed into 600 nautical miles), and then we can imagine many scenes: 600 nautical miles Food, love in 600 nautical miles, wind and rain in 600 nautical miles.
600 N MILE是一家以台湾美食为特色的综合休闲店铺，包括台湾牛肉面、烧烤、咖啡、果汁、啤酒、冰淇淋等等，这里是厦门海滩栈道线上一个贴心的
‘充电“小站，是游客驻足打卡的一个网点，是周边人群夜晚聚会轰趴的一个据点。
600 N MILE is a comprehensive leisure shop featuring Taiwanese cuisine, including Taiwanese beef noodles, barbecue, coffee, juice, beer, ice cream, etc. This is a thoughtful place on the boardwalk in Xiamen Beach
The ‘charging’ station is an outlet for tourists to stop and check in, and a stronghold for the surrounding crowds to gather at night.
小站在原有的基础上改造而来，重新搭建的雨棚、厨房、吧台，更换了围栏，新铺了地板，修整了树木；整个风格以白色为主，用现代简约的语言组织着空间和家具、装饰，夜晚，线性的灯光勾勒着小站的轮廓，是一种体量感和识别度，就像是灯塔对于水手，是希望和归宿。
The small station was transformed from the original foundation. The canopy, kitchen and bar counter were rebuilt, the fence was replaced, the floor was newly laid, and the trees were trimmed; the whole style is mainly white, and the space and space are organized in a modern and simple language. Furniture, decoration, and at night, linear lights outline the outline of the small station, which is a sense of volume and recognition, just like a lighthouse for sailors, it is hope and destination.
